# Independent audit: robust inner triangle and local critical scope

Audited the complete revised source
`candidate 3a87cc28ce06445f`.
Result: PASS. This audit refers to the strengthened cap-contraction proof,
with eta <= 2-sqrt(33)/3, not the superseded radius/strip proof at eta=1/128.
The associated scope revisions in the thin-support, antipodal, and aligned
simplex sources also pass. None is a general OC resolution.

## 1. Actual cover and nonheavy consequences

The canonical three normals sum to zero. Their A thresholds are -1 and
their middle thresholds are zero, so both trace families cover the whole
continuous plane. B subset T makes its three captured areas zero, including
actual boundary faces, whose planar measure is zero. The proper A caps
have positive areas u<=v<=w. The middle source is interior, so all middle
cap areas Q-u,Q-v,Q-w are positive.

The ordinary positive-part cap-cover profile, with thresholds u and Q-w,
gives

    a<=w+v+u/4,  k<=9Q/4-F,  F=u+v+w/4.

Assuming Q<=2(a+k+b)/9 gives k<=a+b-2F and
Q<=4(a+b-F)/9. The NONHEAVY condition b<=a+k then implies F<=a.
Thus delta=a-u-v>=w/4>0 and delta<=w. The actual strict residuals of the
two smaller A caps overlap in positive area, not merely in a scalar
volume menu. Any point there has third normal value >2. Consequently
the largest cap's actual support height H=h_A(v_l)+1 is >3. The bad
target therefore supplies the valid upper bound Q<=2+w/3, using b<=9/2.

## 2. Contraction and actual inner facet

If p attains the largest support and D is its original captured A portion,
then p+(1-eta/H)(D-p) lies in the shifted portion A_eta at threshold
-1+eta. The scale is positive. Therefore

    |A_eta| >= (1-eta/H)^2 w >= (1-eta/3)^2 w.

This is a homothety inside the ACTUAL fiber; no replacement body or
section-density approximation is present. The shifted cut remains proper.
The selected facet of (1-eta)T is an actual segment in B, of length
3(1-eta)||v_l||. Its Minkowski sum with A_eta has exact area

    |A_eta|+3(1-eta)(H-eta).

Indeed every parallel nonempty convex slice is an interval; addition of
the segment increases its length by precisely the segment length, and
integration is over the perpendicular projection. After the midpoint
scale, this entire set is in the ORIGINAL middle cap. Hence

    Q > [1+(1-eta/3)^2/4]w +3(1-eta)(3-eta)/4.

The strictness follows from H>3 and 1-eta>0. Subtracting the bad upper
bound leaves

    [2/3+(1-eta/3)^2/4]w +1/4-3eta+3eta^2/4.

The constant polynomial has its smaller root eta_*=2-sqrt(33)/3,
is nonnegative on [0,eta_*], and the w coefficient is strictly positive.
Thus the contradiction is strict even at eta=eta_* and proves the strict
source inequality Q>2M/9. At eta=1/12 the constant term is exactly 1/192.
The inequalities 1/12<eta_*<1 follow by squaring positive numbers:
23^2>16*33 and sqrt(33)>3.

## 3. Missing area and all ambient halfspaces

For a full d-dimensional ordinary convex L, centroid g, and convex compact
B subset L, the stated core implication is correct. If
x=(1-eta)p+eta g is outside B, the actual homothetic body
(1-eta)p+eta L lies inside L and has centroid x. A closed halfspace
containing x and strictly disjoint from B captures at least
Gamma_d eta^d |L| of this body. This contradicts the assumed missing
volume. For the stated planar application eta=1/12, the relative constant
is exactly (4/9)(1/12)^2=1/324.

When B is heavy its OWN ordinary centroid belongs to the actual endpoint
fiber and every ambient halfspace containing it captures at least
Gamma_2 b from that fiber alone, including a whole-fiber trace. Hence its
raw depth exceeds 2M/9. This does not attribute that bound to the original
middle source. In the nonheavy case the conclusion applies to the source
because Q is its genuine infimum over ALL ambient halfspaces, not merely
the three displayed cap values. All measures are actual planar fiber
areas, and no lattice coordinate or integer base is changed.

## 4. Scope changes in the related sources

The comparison Q>=Gamma_d k is automatic whenever the actual middle
traces cover K and every displayed total cap has mass Q: one middle
trace contains the ordinary centroid of K, so its middle mass alone is
at least Gamma_d k. This removes a redundant global-depth-maximizer
premise in both aligned-simplex sources, without requiring B nonheavy.

For the thin-support and all-dimensional antipodal sources put X=a+k.
Their two selected ACTUAL caps prove X<=2Q+E. Under a hypothetical bad
target and B nonheavy,

    Q<=Gamma_d(X+b)/2<=Gamma_d X,
    E>=X-2Q>=(1-2Gamma_d)X>=(1-2Gamma_d)b.

Thus the former comparison Q>=Gamma_d b is unnecessary. In the plane
this is E>=b/9 and contradicts the same exact error bound
E/b<=2025/25088<1/9. In general dimension d>=2 it contradicts the
stated strict error threshold. The bad-target mass estimates k<=9b/7
and k<=3b follow directly from the middle cap profiles, not from a
global maximizing property. Heavy B is treated by its actual centroid.

All previous geometric normalization, radius, contact, and boundary-mass
checks in `historical context (not an accepted premise)`
remain valid. The current assumptions are weaker than those in that
older audit; its global comparisons are now redundant, not new hypotheses.

## 5. Additional aligned-simplex support-deficit check

For arbitrary K, the circumscribed aligned simplex Kbar contains K and
satisfies the geometric strict credit |Kbar|>b/rho_d. The actual cap
profiles still give a+k<=Q/Gamma_d+C_d Q. Under a bad target,
k<=Q/Gamma_d<=b/(1-Gamma_d C_d), all denominators positive. Consequently
k/|Kbar|<rho_d/(1-Gamma_d C_d). The stated exact values
6/7,12/13,690/851, and 3rho_d (d>=5) are correct. This is only a
necessary support-simplex deficit; no ordinary-depth stability from it
is assumed.

The independent exact checker is
`supporting computation verify_robust_inner_triangle_scope_audit_slab_recovery.py`.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
